mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS async_task_record ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, task_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, task_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, task_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, business_key VARCHAR(128), status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, progress_percent INT NOT NULL, total_count BIGINT NOT NULL, completed_count BIGINT NOT NULL, retry_count INT NOT NULL, max_retry_count INT NOT NULL, request_payload TEXT, result_payload TEXT, error_message VARCHAR(1024), worker_id VARCHAR(128), last_heartbeat_at DATETIME, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, started_at DATETIME, finished_at DATETIME, expire_at DATETIME NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY uk_async_task_record_task_id (task_id), KEY idx_async_task_record_owner_created_at (owner_id, created_at), KEY idx_async_task_record_owner_business_key_created_at (owner_id, business_key, created_at), KEY idx_async_task_record_owner_status_created_at (owner_id, status, created_at), KEY idx_async_task_record_type_status_created_at (task_type, status, created_at), KEY idx_async_task_record_status_heartbeat (status, last_heartbeat_at), KEY idx_async_task_record_expire_at (expire_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO async_task_record ( task_id, owner_id, task_type, task_name, business_key, status, progress_percent, total_count, completed_count, retry_count, max_retry_count, request_payload, result_payload, error_message, worker_id, last_heartbeat_at, created_at, updated_at, started_at, finished_at, expire_at ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{ownerId}, #{taskType}, #{taskName}, #{businessKey}, #{status}, #{progressPercent}, #{totalCount}, #{completedCount}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetryCount}, #{requestPayload}, #{resultPayload}, #{errorMessage}, #{workerId}, #{lastHeartbeatAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{expireAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE async_task_record SET owner_id = #{ownerId}, task_type = #{taskType}, task_name = #{taskName}, business_key = #{businessKey}, status = #{status}, progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, total_count = #{totalCount}, completed_count = #{completedCount}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, max_retry_count = #{maxRetryCount}, request_payload = #{requestPayload}, result_payload = #{resultPayload}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, worker_id = #{workerId}, last_heartbeat_at = #{lastHeartbeatAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, expire_at = #{expireAt} WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM async_task_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE async_task_record SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW(), finished_at = NOW() WHERE expire_at <= #{expireBefore} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE async_task_record SET status = 'CREATED', worker_id = #{workerId}, last_heartbeat_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(), error_message = NULL WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND ( ( status = 'CREATED' AND created_at <= #{heartbeatBefore} ) OR ( status = 'RUNNING' AND (last_heartbeat_at IS NULL OR last_heartbeat_at <= #{heartbeatBefore}) ) )
